body:
## Context
Issue #209: `adlc ticket complete <id>` does not accept `--expect <ticketHash>`, leaving a same-ticket TOCTOU window between when the ceremony-drift issue is rendered and when an admin executes the completion command.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `TicketService.planComplete(id, { expect, authorized })` and `adlc ticket complete <id> [--expect <ticket-hash>]` refuse with `conflict('STALE_TICKET', `ticket ${id} hash changed`)` (exit code 2, no mutation) when `expect` is provided and does not match the current `snapshot.ticketHashes[id]`.
- `packages/ticket-prune` threads `ticketHash` (`ticketHash(ticket)` from `@adlc/tickets`) onto `needsCeremony` entries.
- `scripts/ceremony-drift.mjs` renders `--expect <ticketHash>` in `completeCmd` when `t.ticketHash` is a valid 64-hex sha256 digest.
- `packages/ticket-prune/README.md` and the `adlc-maintain` docs drop the `"planned follow-up"` caveat and document `--expect <ticket-hash>`.

## Verification
`node --test packages/tickets/test/service.test.mjs packages/tickets/test/help.test.mjs packages/ticket-prune/test/detect.test.mjs packages/ticket-prune/test/run.test.mjs scripts/test/ceremony-drift.test.mjs scripts/test/ceremony-drift-exit.test.mjs scripts/test/ceremony-command-safety.test.mjs`
title: tickets,ticket-prune: add adlc ticket complete --expect <hash> and render it in ceremony-drift (#209)
